items.title: TJ Maxx, Marshalls Kept Tariff Refunds for Executive Bonuses
items.summary: TJX brands were among a handful of companies named in a report for disclosing their intent to give bonuses to leadership instead of reimbursing shoppers that paid higher prices for tariff-impacted products.

items.title: Deutsche Bank favours Ross Stores and TJX for earnings upside into 2027
items.summary: Investing.com -- Deutsche Bank remains bullish on Ross Stores and TJX Companies, identifying the two off-price retailers as its preferred stocks heading into 2027, as their value-focused business models position them to benefit from holiday shopping demand and consumers’ continued focus on affordability.
